question: A monkey tries to ascend a greased pole 62 meters high. He climbs 5 meters in the first minute and slips down 2 meters in the next minute. If this pattern continues, in how many minutes will he reach the top of the pole?
explanation:
In every 2-minute cycle, the net ascent = 5 - 2 = 3 meters.
Before the final jump of 5 meters, distance needed = 62 - 5 = 57 meters.
Number of 2-minute cycles = 57 / 3 = 19 cycles (= 38 minutes).
At 38 minutes, the monkey is at 57 meters. In the next minute, he climbs 5 meters to reach exactly 62 meters.
Total time = 38 + 1 = 39 minutes.

question: A contractor undertook to complete a road project in 60 days and employed 40 men. After 20 days, he found that only 1/4 of the work was completed. How many additional men must he employ to finish the project strictly on schedule?
explanation:
Using chain rule: (M1 × D1) / W1 = (M2 × D2) / W2
(40 × 20) / 1/4 = (M2 × 40) / (1 - 1/4)
Total men required M2 = 60.
Additional men to hire = 60 - 40 = 20 men.
